patterns.prevention:
• **Conduct** immediate quality audits of all active coaches, focusing on engagement, energy levels, and session consistency—flag any with attendance issues or low feedback scores for retraining or reassignment within 5 days.

• **Establish** a backup coach protocol requiring every centre to have a named replacement coach trained and ready to step in within 2 weeks, preventing service gaps when primary coaches leave.

• **Schedule** 1-on-1 check-ins with centre managers at risk of cancellation to confirm coach satisfaction, equipment adequacy, and program challenge level—action any gaps immediately.

• **Communicate** clearly with centres upfront about coach tenure and succession plans to avoid surprises like "coach won't be long-term," and set expectations for consistency from day one.
